dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Would you like to plant a tree with me?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's plant a big one!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Bigger than all those trees outside.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I can teach you some ninjutsu using leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, and they are all escape techniques...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Um, because escaping is very important! Especially when going up against really strong enemies!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I don't want to see you get hurt...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then I'll be counting on you to teach me.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: After that, we can climb up the tree for a rest.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Sitting on the trunk, enjoying the wind...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: *yawn*... Just thinking about it... makes me a little sleepy.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: *yawn*...I hope I dream of you every time I fall asleep...
